maya_cs: Quick heads-up for QBR prep — Apollo activation cohort spiked tokens after embeddings turned on. Need a 5-slide appendix + short mitigation. :warning:
liam_csm: How big a spike? numbers pls.
olivia_finops: Quick run: expected ~90k/day, observed ~380k/day. Commit is 60k credits/mo. If sustained monthly ~8.5M tokens (~$3.4k).
devsam: billing-bot posted anomaly @08:02 `pct_change=+322%`. Root cause: client disabled local embedding cache + very small batch_size.
maya_cs: Can we give them a one-line fix to paste?
devsam: Snippet:
```
// enable client cache
client.init({ embeddings: { cache: true, batch_size: 32 } })
```
Also suggest temporary soft cap.
liam_csm: Recommend a 48h soft cap 6 reqs/sec for embeddings and alert on 24h spend > $1.2k. Olivia will add cost delta slide.
olivia_finops: I'll include remediation savings and a rollback procedure in the appendix.
